vibe: Sobre et professionnel, authoritative, clean, data-first.

rules.general: Never use Inter or Roboto for headings. Headings must have tight tracking. Body text needs high legibility for data density.

color_palette.rules: Strict adherence to monochrome base with functional color. The UI should be 95% achromatic. Brand blue (#002FA7) is reserved for primary actions (CTAs). Status colors are for grades, alerts, and payment success/failure only.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard, but highly structured. p-6 for inner card padding, gap-4 or gap-6 for dashboard widget spacing.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_layout: F-Pattern layout. Vertical collapsible left sidebar for navigation. Top-left quadrant reserved for primary metrics or upcoming immediate schedule.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_radii: Sharp and rigid. Use rounded-none or max rounded-md (6px). Surfaces rely on 1px crisp borders (border-zinc-200) rather than heavy drop shadows.
layout_and_spacing.rules: No full-screen gradients. Data density is high but progressive disclosure is used (hide complex settings behind tabs). Always left-align dense content and forms.

components.surfaces: Use 'Grid Borders' style. Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border, no ambient shadows. On hover for interactive cards, use slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-sm.
components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#002FA7] text-white hover:bg-[#00227A]. Secondary: bg-white border border-zinc-200 text-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-50.
components.navigation: Vertical left sidebar with active states highlighted by a subtle left border or background tint (bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-900).
components.data_display: Shadcn UI Tables for grades. Recharts for grade evolution. Custom CSS Grid for Timetable/Schedule.
components.forms: Shadcn UI inputs. Left-aligned labels. Use clear, high-contrast focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#002FA7]).

images.description: Minimal architecture. Use as a split-screen background for the Login/Register page.
Minimalist book arrangement. Use as placeholder cover for library books.
Clean bookshelf view. Use as secondary placeholder cover for library.

motion.transitions: Fast and purposeful. 150ms ease-in-out for hovers.
motion.interactions: Use subtle micro-interactions on table rows and schedule blocks (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-50).

icons.style: Clean, consistent stroke width (2px). Use for sidebar navigation and quick actions.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_rules: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, tabs) and key informational elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case representing their role. Example: data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='nav-grades-link'.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA contrast ratios against backgrounds. Focus rings are mandatory for keyboard navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a French SaaS application for schools/universities. All UI text must be in French.
Build a Left Sidebar layout with these sections: Tableau de bord, Notes, Emploi du temps, Paiements, Bibliothèque, Messagerie, Notifications.
Ensure multi-role support context (Student, Teacher, Admin). Provide a mocked toggle or distinct views.
Grades (Notes): Display data in Shadcn Tables. Include a Recharts line chart showing average evolution.
Timetable (Emploi du temps): Use a CSS Grid layout to simulate a weekly calendar.
Payments (Paiements): Mock a Stripe payment interface with clear status badges (Payé, En attente).
Library (Bibliothèque): Show a catalog of books using the provided image URLs as covers.
Messaging (Messagerie): Build a split-pane layout (sidebar for contacts, main area for chat).
Strictly follow the color palette: use white/gray for structure and #002FA7 solely for primary actions.
Use Shadcn UI components extensively (Cards, Tables, Tabs, Dialogs, Forms) but ensure border-radius is overridden to rounded-md or rounded-none to match the Swiss design archetype.
Install and apply 'Outfit' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text via Google Fonts.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive element without exception.
